Technical specifications · Rev 0.1 · 02 Nov 2026

Distilled Fuel Oil (DFO)

04 / DISTILLATE INDUSTRIAL FUEL · REV 0.1 | 02 NOV 2026

Provisional Rerol grade for furnace / burner use; not an automotive fuel.

DOCUMENT RRL-QC-DFO-004

A. Proposed industrial performance targets

PROPERTYREROL ENGINEERING TARGETTEST
AppearanceHomogeneous; no free water or debrisVisual
Density @ 15 °C850-950 kg/m3 (provisional)ASTM D4052
KV @ 50 °C5-60 mm²/s (provisional)ASTM D445
Flash point, PMC≥66 °C; ≥70 °C preferredASTM D93
Pour point≤18 °C (application dependent)ASTM D97
Water≤0.20% by volumeASTM D95
Sediment≤0.10% by massASTM D473
Ash≤0.05% by massASTM D482
Total sulphur≤1.5% by mass; stricter if requiredASTM D4294
Gross calorific valueReport; 9,800-10,500 kcal/kg indicativeASTM D240
Carbon residue≤5% by mass, proposed targetASTM D4530

B. Waste-derived-fuel contaminant gate (where applicable)

CONTAMINANTRELEVANT MAXIMUMBASIS
PCB<2 mg/kgSchedule V Part B
Lead / Arsenic≤100 / ≤5 mg/kg, respectivelySchedule V Part B
Cd + Cr + Ni combined≤500 mg/kgSchedule V Part B
PAH / total halogens≤6% / ≤4,000 mg/kgSchedule V Part B
Sulphur / water / sediment≤4.5% / ≤1.0% v/v / ≤0.25% m/mSchedule V Part B

IMPORTANT DFO is a working trade description, not itself an IS-grade certification. IS 1593:2018 is the reference for furnace/fuel-oil grades (LV grade has ≤80 cSt @ 50 °C and ≥66 °C flash point), but full conformance requires all applicable tests.

DISPATCH Confirm fuel classification and permitted end use with TNPCB / the purchaser. Release only against the actual batch COA, including relevant contaminants; do not blend nonconforming hazardous material into fuel.

REFERENCE BASIS IndianOil IS 1593:2018 fuel-oil table; Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules, 2016 Schedule V Part B.
